QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_30

question.text: An SIA is offered a second engagement by the same SE - Grameen Urja Pvt Ltd - a rural solar FPE - for a SAS 500 assessment, having already conducted a prior SAS 500 engagement for the same SE two years ago. Which ethical principle is most directly engaged?

answer.text: Independence and objectivity, including freedom from bias and conflict of interest

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.108 describes Independence as freedom from bias and conflict of interest while maintaining objectivity. Workbook p.110 reinforces objectivity and conflict-of-interest language. Workbook p.125 links engagement acceptance to independence and professional competence. Together, these pages identify independence and objectivity as the principle directly engaged when considering a repeat engagement. The Trap: Cultural sensitivity (A), constructive feedback (C), and non-judgmental attitude (D) are CoC values but do not specifically address the independence/conflict-of-interest concern raised by repeat engagements. Note: The source-supported principle is independence/objectivity/freedom from conflict of interest, evaluated at engagement acceptance per p.125.
